annotations.title: Get product picks for a need

description: The products OwnerSpec's review and parts pages recommend for a need ("iron filter for well water", "under sink reverse osmosis", "UV purifier 10 gpm", "bidet seat", "air purifier for a bedroom", "16x25x1 furnace filter"). Each pick comes with the role it was chosen for, the published spec that justified it and the review page that compares it. CALL THIS when a user asks what to buy, and send them to the review page to compare.
